name: Kaju Khajoor Cookies
ingredients:
WHEAT FLOUR, SUGAR, EDIBLE VEGETABLE OILS (PALM), INVERT SYRUP, CASHEW NUTS (1.6%), BUTTER, RAISING AGENTS [INS-503 (ii), INS-500 (ii)], MAIZE STARCH, EDIBLE COMMON SALT, DATES (0.3%), MILK SOLIDS, PERMITTED EMULSIFIERS (INS-322, INS - 471), STABILISING AGENT [INS-450(i)], DOUGH CONDITIONER (INS-223). 
CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURAL COLOUR (INS-160b) AND ADDED FLAVOURS (ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES - BUTTER, MILK VANILLA AND NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCE-BUTTER). 
CONTAINS WHEAT, MILK, SOYA & SULPHITE AS HYPERSENSITIVE INGREDIENTS.
